name: @galeon/brain-link-plugin
description: Galeon Brain Link — AI trading intelligence plugin for MetaMask Agent Wallet

brain:check.description: Check a token with Galeon Brain AI before trading. Returns direction, confidence, risk, and historical win rate.

brain:decision.description: Get Galeon Brain's current AI decision for any token — direction, confidence, voting breakdown.

brain:risk.description: Assess risk for a proposed trade using Galeon Brain's 12-dimension AI analysis.

brain:auto-trade.description: Enable AI auto-trade. Galeon Brain will automatically execute trades on Kuru DEX based on its signals.

brain:positions.description: View active AI-managed positions, PnL, and trade history.

brain:status.description: Check Galeon Brain Link service status and recent activity.
